done_when: When two rounds in a row leave the same failing test or finding, or the change grows past its size limit, Forge stops the item and prints a ready-to-ask question naming the item, what is stuck and what the worker tried, with the choices: switch this item to the other tool, keep the same tool for one more round, or narrow or split; the owner's choice is recorded and the next round follows it

findings.body: Raise: Not done. When a worker fixes a review finding but introduces a failing test, close.py:233-237 stops before another review and keeps the old finding in state. This line counts that unverified finding again on the next `forge work`, so Forge asks the owner even though the second round left a different failure. The A-then-B proof covers two test failures, but not a finding followed by a test failure.
findings.title: Not done: a stale review finding can stop an item after a different failure

findings.body: Raise: Functional. worker.py:391 retains only the last 30 lines of a failed pull-request check. In a normal Jest run with a long stack trace, the test name can fall outside that tail while the generic `Tests: 1 failed` summary remains. This line then gives different failing tests in the same check the same key and stops the item prematurely. The named Jest proof uses one-line output, so it does not exercise the truncated CI log.
findings.title: Different tests can share the same truncated CI failure excerpt

findings.body: Raise: Gate. A normal `--resolve switch` call without `--reason` reaches this refusal, but `bad_choice` at close.py:57-59 tells the owner to retry with `<narrow|split|accept>`. That omits the chosen `switch` option and offers `accept`, which this new branch rejects for a stuck stop. The refusal therefore fails Forge's rule that every refusal name the real problem and the next action.
findings.title: A rejected stuck choice gives an invalid recovery command

why: When a worker can't fix a problem or keeps making the change bigger, Forge sends it back round after round and nobody is told
